title: useQuerySelect
subtitle: Hook that returns QueryState with optimized re-renders
description: A hook that returns the full QueryState object but with optimized re-renders based on which properties of the state are actually used in the component.

rows.name: queryKey
rows.description: Unique identifier for the query. Can be a string or array of primitives.

rows.name: options
rows.description: Optional configuration object. If no fetcher is provided, uses a previously registered fetcher.

returns.description: The complete query state object with optimized re-renders based on property usage

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.description: Access query state with optimized re-renders

examples.title: State Property Access
examples.description: Access specific state properties with optimized re-renders

behavior.title: State-Based Optimization
behavior.description: Returns full QueryState but only re-renders when accessed state properties change

behavior.title: Performance Optimized
behavior.description: Automatically optimizes re-renders based on which state properties are used

behavior.title: Full State Access
behavior.description: Provides access to all QueryState properties (data, isLoading, error, etc.)

behavior.title: Type Safe
behavior.description: Full TypeScript support with proper type inference

dos: Use for accessing specific state properties with optimization
Access only the state properties you need in your component
Use TypeScript for better type safety
Handle all state properties appropriately (data, isLoading, error, etc.)
donts: Don't use for simple data access (use useQueryData instead)
Don't access all state properties if you only need a few
Don't forget to handle loading and error states
Don't use for complex data transformations

callouts.title: State-Based Optimization
callouts.content: useQuerySelect returns the full QueryState object but only re-renders when the specific state properties you access change.
